method.household_benchmark: BLS 2024 three-person consumer units; national average, not a particular family or exactly two adults and one child
method.budget_source_title: BLS 2024 consumer expenditures by consumer-unit size, three persons
method.formula: Day/public value = six-category community score * 64877 / (12 * local 3-bedroom HUD gross rent + other annual household spending + enrolled children * annual school cost + household school fees). Boarding compares annual cost only: current-home annual spending + boarding package and fees + known travel.
method.budget_note: Other household spending retains food, transportation, health and vehicle insurance, phone/internet and household goods; primary shelter and HUD-covered utilities are removed before adding local gross rent. The residual is held at national 2024 prices, not scaled by an all-items regional index. Housing estimates use their stated source year. These are planning benchmarks, not actual bills; adjust household spending and tuition/aid with official sources.
method.school_cost_basis: Day and boarding are separately sourced attendance scenarios under one school ID. Published costs and known mandatory fees before aid; unknown mandatory charges retain cost floors. Boarding retains the family at its current home, represented by an editable national three-person benchmark until personalized. No automatic savings while a child boards; current-home spending may overlap meals provided at school. Travel starts unpriced. Five-day boarding requires home-weekend arrangements. Campus community quality of life is not used to rank family value for boarding.
